title: Incoterms 2020 Obligations: EXW vs FCA vs DAP Risk Transfer
workplace_track: Export Logistics & Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DDP)
description: Intermediate sales and logistics module analyzing incoterms 2020 obligations: exw vs fca vs dap risk transfer.
learning_objectives: Master professional Passive Voice & Responsibility Clauses in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in incoterms 2020 obligations: exw vs fca vs dap risk transfer
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: Under Incoterms 2020 DAP terms, the seller _____ responsible for unloading the trucks at the buyer's destination terminal.

explanations.correct: Under DAP (Delivered at Place), seller delivers ready for unloading; unloading is buyer's obligation.
explanations.wrong_C: 'shall to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'shall' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Incoterms 2020: Under DAP, risk transfers before unloading. Seller 'is not' responsible for offloading costs.
